tagline: Family-owned tree service in Northridge for 25 years
lede: Removals, trimming, stump grinding and palms, done by the same family for more than 25 years. Call for an estimate.
about: Reyes Tree Services handles tree work across Northridge and nearby towns: tree removal, tree trimming & pruning, stump grinding, palm tree trimming.

services.name: Tree Removal
services.short: Safe removal of any size tree, cleanup included.
services.body: We take down trees of any size, including tight spots near houses, fences and power lines. We cut it in sections when there's no room to drop it, haul everything away and leave the yard clean.
faqs: Yes. Branches, logs and debris all go with us unless you want the firewood.

services.name: Tree Trimming & Pruning
services.body: Trimming keeps branches off the roof and the wires, lets light into the yard and keeps the tree healthy. We cut to the right spot so the tree heals well instead of sprouting back weak.
faqs: How often should trees be trimmed?
Most yard trees every two to three years. Fast growers and trees near the house more often.

services.name: Stump Grinding
services.body: We grind the stump below ground so you can plant grass or build over it, and clean up the chips or leave them as mulch.

services.name: Palm Tree Trimming
services.short: Dead fronds and seed pods cleared.
services.body: Dead fronds are a fire and pest risk. We clear them, remove the seed pods and skin the trunk if you want the clean look.
